description: A small INVENTED question set that exercises the harness end to end: four answerable role questions (two of them multi-hop) and four questions where abstention is the correct response, one per abstention reason the schema admits. The subject matter — a catalogue of software components and the teams accountable for them — is fictional and carries no real organisation, team, service or person. It is a fixture for the code, NOT an evaluation corpus: `labelling` is `synthetic_fixture`, so `arms.py` refuses to admit or refuse a phase from it.
answer_path: arm 1 (status quo) is an external answer path and is not present in this repository — see README.md

questions.question: Which team maintains parser-core?

hops.note: The authored field. Single hop: the node-first read should settle this one.

questions.note: The easy case. If the whole set looked like this, node-first would clear it and nothing expensive is admitted.

questions.question: Which team maintains ledger-sync?
questions.note: The conflation case: the note's own author is stated three lines above the maintainer, and a path that ranks notes rather than reading a named field answers with the author. Graded as `conflated`, separately from a plain miss.

questions.question: Which team maintains signal-router?
questions.note: The entity resolves and its note exists, but records no maintainer. Abstain; do not fall back to whoever the surrounding prose mentions most.

questions.question: Which team maintains the router?
questions.note: Two catalogue entries answer to 'router' (signal-router, route-planner). Return candidates or abstain; never pick one.

questions.question: Which team maintains invoice-mailer?
questions.note: No such component in the catalogue. An arm that answers here has invented an entity.

questions.question: Which team maintains the component parser-core uses for schema validation?

target.surface: the component parser-core uses for schema validation

hops.note: States that parser-core validates schemas through schema-guard. Suppress this line and the question is unanswerable — which is what the shortcut control checks.

questions.note: Two hops. The bridge is a prose sentence in one note, not a field, so no single authored read reaches it.

questions.question: Which team maintains route-planner?
questions.note: The only maintainer on record carries a closed validity interval and names no successor. Answering returns a former holder of the role with full confidence — the failure a role fact without a validity interval produces.

questions.question: Which team maintains the component ledger-sync publishes its checkpoints to?

target.surface: the component ledger-sync publishes its checkpoints to

hops.note: States that ledger-sync publishes checkpoints to archive-vault.

questions.note: A second multi-hop question, so the connected-reasoning denominator is not one question wide.
